register.text: Short-term Islamic securities that the Brunei Government issues through the Brunei Darussalam Central Bank, with tenors of 91 to 364 days and rental rates of 1.0625% to 1.25% in 2026. register.name: Development Fund, 12th National Development Plan, 2026/2027
register.detail: Ministry of Finance and Economy · presented to the Legislative Council, March 2026 · social well-being BND309.8M · economy BND148.2M · fiscal governance BND22.0M
register.note: Lists national housing at Kampong Lugu (Phase 2, 1,500 houses) and Tanah Jambu (Phase 7), sewerage upgrades and clean water supply
register.text: The development allocation for the 2026/2027 financial year under the 12th National Development Plan (RKN12), in three areas of focus. BND309.8 million is for social well-being, under which the Ministry lists national housing at Kampong Lugu (Phase 2, 1,500 houses) and Tanah Jambu (Phase 7), the upgrading of the sewerage system and clean water supply. Housing and sanitation make up shelter, the standard furthest from reach in Brunei.

items.name: SMARTER Brunei
items.text: A society for autistic people and their families that runs social enterprises, the SMARTER Bakery (2014), the SMARTER Bistro and Café (2017) and the BJAK Café among them, to give autistic adults real jobs, real wages and real pathways to independence. In March 2025 it relaunched the SMARTER Autism Shop, its first social enterprise, opened in 2008.
